mapper.verbatim_quote: os dados de tráfego devem ser conservados pelo operador, por um período mínimo de um ano, contado a partir data em que foram originados
mapper.rationale: Explicit minimum retention period (one year) for traffic data by telecom operators satisfies 7.3's minimum-duration test; sectoral (telecom) scope.

verifier.reason: Art. 8(1) of TL telecom regulation mandates minimum retention of traffic data for AT LEAST one year ("período mínimo de um ano"). This clearly specifies a minimum duration (12 months). No trap conditions apply: this is telecom/traffic data (carrier context, consistent with 7.3 guidance); the requirement is duration-based (not location-based like 6.2); minimum period is explicitly stated (not a "as necessary" maximum). Scoring tree fires: minimum period requirement with specified duration → score 1.

mapper.verbatim_quote: A pessoa autorizada deve conservar os registos nos respetivos escritórios em Timor-Leste
mapper.rationale: Sector-specific (petroleum operations) local storage-location requirement for records; single sectoral measure -> 0.5 under 6.2 scoring tree.

verifier.reason: Art. 167(4) requires records be kept in offices in Timor-Leste, but concerns OPERATIONAL PROJECT DATA within petroleum operations, not personal data as defined under RDTII 2.1 (personal data = information relating to identified/identifiable individuals: name, email, ID, health, etc.). This is sectoral record-keeping for a specific industry's operational/technical files. Government-data exception also bars scoring (records held/approved by Ministry). 6.2 trap check: the provision specifies WHERE records must reside (a locus rule, not duration) — formally location-based — but the data subject matter is neither personal data nor non-personal data in the commercial privacy sense. Measure falls outside RDTII 2.1's scope (commercial transactions in personal/sensitive non-personal data). Does not apply.

escalation.reason: Art. 167(4) requires the authorized person to keep records in its offices in Timor-Leste (or elsewhere in TL if it ceases activity) — a LOCATION/domestic-storage mandate, not duration (7.3) nor an establishment/data-centre build (6.3). Sector-specific (offshore petroleum records), commercial, so category (2) → 0.5. Para 5 (retention "during the period necessary") is a max-period, not 7.3.

mapper.verbatim_quote: A polícia pode efectuar buscas, revistas ou apreensões, sem mandado Judicial
mapper.rationale: Police may search/seize without judicial warrant in flagrante delicto or urgent suspicion cases; only ex-post reporting to Ministério Público (prosecutor, not an independent judicial body) is required — no prior court authorization.

verifier.reason: Art. 56(1) Código de Processo Penal permits police to conduct searches, seizures and inspections WITHOUT judicial warrant in two circumstances: (a) flagrant crime with custodial penalty, and (b) strong suspicion of crime-related objects with risk of alteration/removal/destruction. This is government access to data/property WITHOUT explicit independent judicial authorization—it is authorized by police discretion alone under statutory conditions, not by a court order. The "trap" check (7.5 governs government access to PERSONAL data without judicial warrant) applies: while the provision nominally governs searches of objects, such searches inherently access personal data, premises, communications and information. The provision does not require a court order or independent judicial body authorization; police authority alone suffices. Scoring tree branch: "Any measure allows the Government to access (personal) data without a court order / independent judicial authorization — including access on regulator or ministerial request, mandatory standing access for agencies, or surveillance authorized by a non-judicial or undefined authority" → score 1.

mapper.verbatim_quote: prever a aquisição de uma proporção mínima de bens e serviços a nível local ou nacional, assim como o emprego de um mínimo de trabalhadores nacionais
mapper.rationale: Local content/local employment requirement applicable to all bidders in public procurement is a limitation under 2.3, scored 0.5 as it applies equally to all suppliers.

verifier.reason: Article 88 permits procurement entities to establish conditions requiring a minimum proportion of goods/services at local or national level, and minimum employment of national workers. This is a local-content requirement applying equally to all bidders (domestic and foreign). Under 2.3 scoring tree, one limitation that applies to all bidders scores 0.5. TRAP checks: (1) Not an exclusion under 2.1—foreign bidders are not barred, only subject to equal local-content conditions; (2) Not source-code/encryption (2.2); (3) This is a limitation, not a preference (which would score 0). One equal-treatment limitation = 0.5 branch.

mapper.verbatim_quote: Adjudicação exclusivamente a empresários nacionais, preferencialmente de carácter local.
mapper.rationale: Exclusive award to national (and preferably local) entrepreneurs excludes foreign firms entirely from this procurement regime, i.e. a full exclusion, not a mere preference.

verifier.reason: Art. 2(1)(b) mandates "adjudicação exclusivamente a empresários nacionais" (exclusive award to national entrepreneurs) in special procurement for priority projects. This is a measure that excludes foreign firms from public procurement of the specified projects. It is a single, specific measure targeting one category of project (value ≤USD 150,000, priority projects meeting defined criteria), not a broad horizontal exclusion and not two or more measures. Trap check: this is a genuine exclusion (2.1), not a preference or limitation (2.3), because foreign bidders cannot participate at all. Scores 0.5 under the second scoring branch.

escalation.reason: Art.2(1)(b) reserves award of these priority projects exclusively to national (preferably local) firms in public procurement. This favours domestic firms rather than barring a specific foreign firm/group. Per the TRAP rules, nationality-based preferences/reservations are 2.3 limitations, not 2.1 exclusions. So for 2.1 this is a no-exclusion reference row scoring 0; the substantive restriction is coded under 2.3.

mapper.verbatim_quote: Um Estado Membro não deverá exigir que um prestador de serviços de outro Estado Membro estabeleça ou mantenha um escritório de representação ou qualquer forma de pessoa coletiva, ou que tenha residência no seu território, como condição para a prestação transfronteiriça de um serviço.
mapper.rationale: This is a prohibition on imposing local presence/representative office requirements for cross-border service supply — the opposite of a 12.8 restriction; it removes rather than imposes such a requirement, so no restriction is evidenced (score 0).

verifier.reason: This is a treaty framework provision (ASEAN Agreement) stating that member states SHALL NOT require local presence. It is a preferential commitment, not a domestic measure. Cross-cutting policy: "Preferential trade-agreement provisions are excluded" (measure_inclusion.non_preferential_only). Additionally, this is an enabling/prohibitory clause on member states, not an enforced domestic regulation of Timor-Leste itself. Indicator 12.8 captures enforced domestic legal measures requiring local presence for online service providers; treaty scheduling is out of scope.

escalation.reason: Art. 9 of the ASEAN services framework PROHIBITS Member States from requiring a representative office, legal person or residence as a condition for cross-border supply. This is a liberalising rule, the opposite of a local presence requirement. No 12.8 obligation is imposed, so the else branch (no local presence precondition) fires at score 0. Note: as a preferential trade-agreement provision it may itself be out of scope, but on the text alone it evidences the ABSENCE of a 12.8 restriction.

mapper.verbatim_quote: um requerente pode ser sujeito à obrigação de manter fundos próprios a níveis especificados pelo Banco Central
mapper.rationale: Licensing requirement with restrictive condition (mandatory own-funds/capital level set by regulator) as precondition to obtain authorization to provide payment services or operate a payment system.

verifier.reason: Art. 7(2) establishes licensing requirements for payment service providers with restrictive conditions. The Central Bank can authorize payment services and impose capital/own-funds requirements at specified levels determined by service type, payment volume, or other factors. This constitutes a licensing requirement with restrictive conditions (capital/own-funds thresholds), triggering 12.4.4 score 1. The trap check (payment licensing ≠ e-commerce licence 12.3, which is separate) is satisfied: this is payment-specific licensing.

mapper.verbatim_quote: mercadorias cujo valor comercial não exceda USD 10 (dez dólares) por remessa
mapper.rationale: De minimis threshold set at USD 10, well below USD 200, so falls in 'below <200 USD' branch scoring 0.5.

verifier.reason: Art. 10(1)-(2) of Timor-Leste's Customs Exemptions Regulation establishes a de minimis threshold of USD 10 per shipment for duty-free importation of non-commercial goods. This directly addresses indicator 12.5 (Low De Minimis), which scores economies on whether they adopt a de minimis threshold and at what level. The scoring tree specifies: '0.5' for de minimis below USD 200; '0' for de minimis ≥ USD 200; '1' for no de minimis. USD 10 falls in the 'below USD 200' category, triggering the 0.5 branch. No trap applies: the threshold is explicitly specified (USD 10), not vague; it is enforced customs law, not a draft; and it is measured in commercial terms (shipment value).

mapper.verbatim_quote: Os membros do órgão de administração e do órgão de fiscalização das companhias de seguros e das sociedades de intermediação de seguros devem residir em território nacional.
mapper.rationale: Residency requirement for board/management and supervisory body members of insurance companies and intermediaries.

verifier.reason: Art. 40(2) mandates that members of the board of administration and supervisory bodies of insurance companies and insurance intermediary entities must reside in national territory. This is a residency requirement for board members and managers, triggering indicator 3.3. Under the binary scoring tree, any measure imposing such requirements scores 1.

mapper.verbatim_quote: são fornecidas ao comprador, antes da finalização da compra, as seguintes informações
mapper.rationale: E-commerce law provides consumer protection disclosures for online purchases (pricing, returns, refunds), so a consumer protection framework exists for online transactions.

verifier.reason: Art. 53(2) is consumer protection law applicable to online commerce: it mandates disclosure of price details, payment methods, return/repair/replacement alternatives, and return periods (min. 7 days) before purchase completion, and prohibits false product reviews. This constitutes evidence of a legal framework protecting consumers in online transactions. TRAP checks: (1) Not inverted-polarity confusion—the provision EXISTS, so score is 0, not 1. (2) Not advertising rules (9.3)—this covers substantive purchase/post-purchase consumer protections beyond ad truthfulness. (3) Not e-signature validity (12.11/12.12)—the provision regulates merchant obligations and consumer rights in online sales. The 'else' branch applies: at least one consumer protection law reaches online purchases.
